_about: The app's own words in English: the source, and the fallback for any key another language doesn't have. {name} placeholders are filled in by the page. Values with markup (<b>, <code>, <a>) are inserted as HTML.
slot.label: Save
mystery.toggle: Spoiler-free: show what you haven't found as ?
mystery.hint: Hides the type, name and contents of everything you haven't found yet
mystery.label: Undiscovered
mystery.note: Each ? is something you haven't found. The layers below only show what you've found.
update.title: Updates
update.switch: Tell me when a new version is out
update.hint: Asks GitHub for the latest release when the app starts and every 12 hours. Nothing is downloaded or installed, and nothing about you or your game is sent.
update.failed: Couldn't reach GitHub to check. It will try again later.
link.title: Where Link was when the game last saved
pop.lynel: Not tracked: Lynels come back after every Blood Moon
player.where: Where you were at the last save
player.whereLive: Where you are now (live from the game)
live.title: Live position
live.switch: Follow Link live while you play
live.hint: Needs Savage Wind started with SAVAGEWIND_CONTROL=7777. On Windows, start it from a .cmd file next to savagewind.exe with the lines set "SAVAGEWIND_CONTROL=7777" and start "" savagewind.exe. The game then answers on a local port (this PC only), and this app asks it where Link is four times a second. It only ever asks for the position and never changes anything in the game. The arrow turns the way the camera looks. Without it, the map shows where you were at the last save.
live.status.missing: Savage Wind isn't answering on its control port (not running, or started without SAVAGEWIND_CONTROL=7777): the map shows where you were at the last save.
live.status.stale: The game stopped answering: the map shows where you were at the last save.
live.status.not_in_world: The game is running, but no save is loaded yet.
live.status.unreadable: The game's answer can't be read right now.
live.status.off: Off: the map shows where you were at the last save.

share.title: Open on your phone
share.note: Only for phones and tablets on the same Wi-Fi or network as this PC. It won't work over mobile data or from another network.
share.what: Shows this map, your quests and progress on the other device, read-only: it can't change anything on this PC.
share.scan: Scan with the phone's camera, or open:
share.firewall: Windows may ask once to allow the app on private networks.
share.firewall.linux: If it doesn't open, allow the app in this PC's firewall.
lan.switch: Show the map on phones and tablets
lan.note: Only devices on the same Wi-Fi or network as this PC can open it (not over mobile data). Read-only: they see your map, quests and progress, but can't change settings or anything on this PC. Windows may ask once to allow the app on private networks. Also in the phone button at the bottom right of the map.

setup.title: Set up BotW Progress Map
setup.lead: Point the app at your Savage Wind folder: the one with savagewind.exe, or its data folder with extracted and save. It reads your saves from there and updates the map whenever the game saves. Nothing is ever written to your game or saves.
setup.browseNote: A folder window opened, it may be behind this browser…
setup.noneFound: No Savage Wind folder found automatically. Click Browse… and pick the folder that has savagewind.exe (or extracted and save).
setup.dataNote: The first time, the app draws the map and finds every shrine, Korok, tower and quest in your own game files (about 20 seconds, 15 MB). Nothing is downloaded. Everything is stored in {dir}.
lang.title: Language
lang.hint: The app, and the place, item and quest names and quest texts, are shown in this language. Names and quest texts come from your game files. Same as the game follows Savage Wind's text language setting.
openBrowser.title: Also open the map in your web browser
quit.title: Stop the app
bye.title: BotW Progress Map stopped.
bye.text: You can close this tab. Open the app again any time to see your progress.
